nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: O desafio de condução e estacionamento mais preciso do Meta Horizon! Esqueça as corridas de alta velocidade – aqui o foco é controle e consciência espacial. Por que você vai amar: física de condução imersiva, pistas com obstáculos, visão superior e dificuldade progressiva. Assuma o controle, verifique os espelhos e estacione em qualquer lugar!
nodes.short_description: Domine a arte de estacionar em VR! Assuma o volante no Car Parking School, onde a precisão é tudo. Navegue por percursos desafiadores e prove que você é um motorista profissional.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: O desafio de condução e estacionamento mais preciso no Meta Horizon! Esquece as corridas de alta velocidade – aqui o foco é o controlo e a consciência espacial. Por que vais adorar: física de condução imersiva, pistas com obstáculos, visão superior e dificuldade progressiva. Agarra o volante e estaciona em qualquer lugar!
nodes.short_description: Domina a arte de estacionar em VR! Senta-te no lugar do condutor no Car Parking School, onde a precisão é tudo. Navega por percursos desafiantes e prova que és um condutor profissional.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: The Most Precise Driving & Parking Challenge on Meta Horizon! Put your driving skills to the ultimate test. It’s all about control, spatial awareness, and steady hands. Experience realistic driving simulation where every inch matters. Features: Immersive physics, challenging courses, top-down views, and progressive difficulty. Grab the wheel and start your lesson now!
nodes.short_description: Master the art of parking in VR! Step into the driver's seat of Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator, where precision is everything. Navigate through challenging obstacle courses and prove you’re a pro driver.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: La sfida di guida e parcheggio più precisa su Meta Horizon! Dimentica le corse ad alta velocità: qui contano il controllo e la consapevolezza spaziale. Perché ti piacerà: fisica di guida immersiva, ostacoli complessi, visuale dall'alto e difficoltà progressiva. Prendi il volante, controlla gli specchietti e parcheggia ovunque!
nodes.short_description: Domina l'arte del parcheggio in VR! Mettiti alla guida in Car Parking School, dove la precisione è fondamentale. Supera percorsi a ostacoli impegnativi e dimostra di essere un pilota esperto.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Thử thách lái xe và đỗ xe chính xác nhất trên Meta Horizon! Hãy quên đi những cuộc đua tốc độ cao - tại đây, sự kiểm soát và khả năng quan sát không gian mới là quan trọng. Tại sao bạn sẽ thích: vật lý lái xe chân thực, các khóa đào tạo phức tạp, nhiều góc nhìn khác nhau và độ khó tăng dần. Hãy cầm lái và bắt đầu bài học của bạn ngay!
nodes.short_description: Làm chủ nghệ thuật đỗ xe trong VR! Ngồi vào ghế lái của Car Parking School, nơi sự chính xác là tất cả. Vượt qua các chướng ngại vật đầy thử thách và chứng minh bạn là tài xế chuyên nghiệp.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: De meest nauwkeurige parkeeruitdaging op Meta Horizon! Vergeet racen op hoge snelheid – hier draait het om controle en ruimtelijk inzicht. Waarom je het geweldig zult vinden: realistische rijfysica, uitdagende hindernisbanen, verschillende camerapunten en progressieve moeilijkheidsgraad. Pak het stuur en laat zien dat je overal kunt parkeren!
nodes.short_description: Beheers de kunst van het parkeren in VR! Neem plaats in de bestuurdersstoel van Car Parking School, waar precisie alles is. Navigeer door uitdagende parkoersen en bewijs dat je een pro-chauffeur bent.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: ¡El desafío de conducción y estacionamiento más preciso en Meta Horizon! Olvida las carreras de alta velocidad: aquí todo se trata de control y conciencia espacial. Por qué te encantará: física de conducción inmersiva, pistas de obstáculos, vista aérea y dificultad progresiva. ¡Toma el volante, revisa los espejos y estaciona en cualquier lugar!
nodes.short_description: ¡Domina el arte de estacionar en VR! Ponte al volante en Car Parking School, donde la precisión lo es todo. Atraviesa circuitos desafiantes y demuestra que eres un conductor profesional.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精準的駕駛與泊車挑戰！忘掉高速賽車吧——在這裡，控制力、空間意識和穩定的操作才是關鍵。在複雜的訓練場中體驗每一寸都至關重要的真實駕駛模擬。推薦理由：沉浸式駕駛物理、挑戰性障礙賽道、頂視圖視角以及循序漸進的難度。握緊方向盤，開始你的駕駛課吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨練泊車藝術！走進《Car Parking School》的駕駛室，精準操控就是一切。在充滿挑戰的障礙賽道中穿梭，證明你是終極職業司機。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Cea mai precisă provocare de condus și parcare de pe Meta Horizon! Uită de cursele de mare viteză – aici totul ține de control și orientare spațială. De ce îți va plăcea: fizică de condus realistă, trasee complexe, vizualizare de sus și dificultate progresivă. Ia volanul în mâini și parchează perfect oriunde!
nodes.short_description: Stăpânește arta parcării în VR! Urcă-te la volan în Car Parking School, unde precizia este totul. Navighează prin trasee cu obstacole și demonstrează că ești un șofer profesionist.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Η πιο ακριβής πρόκληση οδήγησης και παρκαρίσματος στο Meta Horizon! Ξεχάστε τους αγώνες ταχύτητας – εδώ μετράει ο έλεγχος και η αντίληψη του χώρου. Χαρακτηριστικά: ρεαλιστική φυσική οδήγησης, δύσκολες πίστες με εμπόδια, προοδευτική δυσκολία. Πάρτε το τιμόνι, ελέγξτε τους καθρέφτες και παρκάρετε παντού!
nodes.short_description: Κατακτήστε την τέχνη του παρκαρίσματος σε VR! Καθίστε στη θέση του οδηγού στο Car Parking School, όπου η ακρίβεια είναι το παν. Περάστε από δύσκολες διαδρομές και γίνετε επαγγελματίας οδηγός.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon에서 가장 정밀한 운전 및 주차 챌린지! 고속 레이싱은 잊으세요. 이곳에서는 컨트롤과 공간 지각력이 핵심입니다. 현실적인 운전 물리 엔진, 도전적인 장애물 코스, 탑다운 뷰, 점진적인 난이도를 경험해 보세요. 스티어링 휠을 잡고 가상 미러를 확인하며 완벽하게 주차해 보세요!
nodes.short_description: VR로 주차의 달인이 되어보세요! 정밀함이 생명인 Car Parking School의 운전석에 앉아 도전적인 장애물 코스를 통과하고 최고의 프로 드라이버임을 증명하세요.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Nejpřesnější parkovací výzva na Meta Horizon! Zapomeňte na rychlé závodění – tady jde o kontrolu a prostorové vnímání. Proč si hru zamilujete: pohlcující fyzika jízdy, náročné překážkové dráhy, pohledy shora i z třetí osoby a progresivní obtížnost. Chopte se volantu, zkontrolujte zrcátka a zaparkujte kdekoli!
nodes.short_description: Ovládněte umění parkování ve VR! Sedněte si za volant v Car Parking School, kde je přesnost vším. Projíždějte náročnými překážkovými dráhami a dokažte, že jste profesionální řidič.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon'daki en hassas sürüş ve park etme deneyimi! Hız yapmayı unutun; burada önemli olan kontrol ve mekansal farkındalıktır. Neden seveceksiniz: sürükleyici sürüş fiziği, zorlu engel parkurları, tepeden görünüm ve artan zorluk seviyeleri. Direksiyona geçin, aynaları kontrol edin ve ustalığınızı gösterin!
nodes.short_description: VR'da park etme sanatında ustalaşın! Hassasiyetin her şey olduğu Car Parking School'da sürücü koltuğuna geçin. Zorlu parkurları aşın ve profesyonel bir sürücü olduğunuzu kanıtlayın.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest presise kjøre- og parkeringsutfordringen på Meta Horizon! Glem racing i høy fart – her handler det om kontroll og romforståelse. Hvorfor du vil elske det: realistisk kjørefysikk, utfordrende hinderløyper, fugleperspektiv og progressiv vanskelighetsgrad. Ta rattet og vis at du kan parkere hvor som helst!
nodes.short_description: Mestre kunsten å parkere i VR! Sett deg i førersetet i Car Parking School, der presisjon er alt. Naviger gjennom utfordrende baner og bevis at du er en proff sjåfør.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精准的驾驶与泊车挑战！忘掉高速赛车吧——在这里，控制力、空间意识和稳定的操作才是关键。在复杂的训练场中体验每一寸都至关重要的真实驾驶模拟。推荐理由：沉浸式驾驶物理、挑战性障碍赛道、顶视图视角以及循序渐进的难度。握紧方向盘，开始你的驾驶课吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨练泊车艺术！走进《Car Parking School》的驾驶室，精准操控就是一切。在充满挑战的障碍赛道中穿梭，证明你是终极职业司机。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Le défi de conduite et de stationnement le plus précis sur Meta Horizon ! Oubliez la vitesse, ici tout est question de contrôle et de perception spatiale. Pourquoi vous allez l'adorer : physique de conduite immersive, parcours d'obstacles variés, vues de dessus et difficulté progressive. Prenez le volant et montrez que vous pouvez vous garer n'importe où !
nodes.short_description: Maîtrisez l'art du stationnement en VR ! Prenez place dans le simulateur Car Parking School où la précision est reine. Naviguez à travers des parcours complexes et devenez un pro du volant.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精準的駕駛與泊車挑戰！忘掉高速賽車吧——在這裡，控制力、空間意識和穩定的操作才是關鍵。在複雜的訓練場中體驗每一寸都至關重要的真實駕駛模擬。推薦理由：沉浸式駕駛物理、挑戰性障礙賽道、頂視圖視角以及循序漸進的難度。握緊方向盤，開始你的駕駛課吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨練泊車藝術！走進《Car Parking School》的駕駛室，精準操控就是一切。在充滿挑戰的障礙賽道中穿梭，證明你是終極職業司機。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizonin tarkin ajo- ja pysäköintihaaste! Unohda vauhdikas kilpa-ajo – tässä on kyse hallinnasta ja tilan hahmottamisesta. Miksi rakastat sitä: realistinen ajofysiikka, haastavat esteradat, lintuperspektiivi ja nouseva vaikeustaso. Tartu rattiin, tarkista peilit ja pysäköi täydellisesti!
nodes.short_description: Hallitse pysäköinnin taito VR:ssä! Astu Car Parking Schoolin kuljettajan istuimelle, missä tarkkuus on kaikki kaikessa. Läpäise haastavat esteradat ja näytä taitosi ammattikuskina.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizonで最も精密な運転＆駐車チャレンジ！高速レースではなく、コントロールと空間認識能力が試されます。没入感のある運転物理、挑戦的な障害物コース、トップダウン視点、そして徐々に上がる難易度。ハンドルを握り、ミラーを確認して、どこにでも完璧に駐車しましょう！
nodes.short_description: VRで駐車の技術を極めよう！『Car Parking School』の運転席に座り、精密な操作で難関コースを攻略。あなたがプロドライバーであることを証明してください。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Najbardziej precyzyjne wyzwanie parkowania na Meta Horizon! Zapomnij o wyścigach – tutaj liczy się opanowanie i orientacja w przestrzeni. Dlaczego to pokochasz: realistyczna fizyka jazdy, wymagające tory przeszkód, widok z góry i rosnący poziom trudności. Chwyć za kierownicę i zaparkuj idealnie w każdym miejscu!
nodes.short_description: Opanuj sztukę parkowania w VR! Usiądź w fotelu kierowcy Car Parking School, gdzie precyzja jest najważniejsza. Pokonuj trudne tory przeszkód i zostań zawodowym kierowcą.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest præcise køre- og parkeringsudfordring på Meta Horizon! Glem alt om hurtig racing – her handler det om kontrol og rumlig bevidsthed. Hvorfor du vil elske det: realistisk kørefysik, udfordrende forhindringsbaner, top-down-visning og progressiv sværhedsgrad. Grib rattet og vis os, at du kan parkere hvad som helst!
nodes.short_description: Mestrer kunsten at parkere i VR! Sæt dig i førersædet i Car Parking School, hvor præcision er alt. Naviger gennem udfordrende baner og bevis, at du er den ultimative pro-chauffør.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Самый точный симулятор вождения и парковки на Meta Horizon! Забудьте о скоростных гонках — здесь важны контроль и пространственное мышление. Почему вам понравится: реалистичная физика, сложные трассы, вид сверху и прогрессирующая сложность. Беритесь за руль, смотрите в зеркала и припаркуйтесь идеально!
nodes.short_description: Освойте искусство парковки в VR! Сядьте за руль в Car Parking School, где точность — это всё. Проходите сложные трассы с препятствиями и докажите, что вы профи.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description:
The Most Precise Driving & Parking Challenge on Meta Horizon!

Put your driving skills to the ultimate test with Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator. Forget high-speed racing—here, it’s all about control, spatial awareness, and steady hands. Experience a realistic driving simulation where every inch matters as you maneuver your vehicle through complex training grounds designed to challenge even the best drivers.

Why You Will Love It:

Immersive Driving Physics: Feel the weight and handling of your car as you use your VR controllers to steer through intricate courses.

Challenging Obstacle Courses: From rows of traffic cones to narrow barriers and sharp turns, every level is a new lesson in precision.

Top-Down & Third-Person Views: Master your parking from a clear perspective that helps you judge distances perfectly.

Progressive Difficulty: Start with simple parking spots and advance to expert-level courses that require perfect timing and steering.

Skill-Based Rewards: Earn your way to the top by completing levels without hitting a single obstacle.

Grab the wheel, check your mirrors (virtually!), and show us that you can park anything, anywhere. Your driving lesson starts now!
nodes.short_description: Master the art of parking in VR! Step into the driver's seat of Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator, where precision is everything. Navigate through challenging obstacle courses, tight corners, and narrow pathways to reach the perfect park. With realistic 3D handling and increasingly difficult levels, can you prove you’re the ultimate pro driver?

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest precisa kör- och parkeringsutmaningen på Meta Horizon! Glöm höghastighetsracing – här handlar allt om kontroll och rumsuppfattning. Varför du kommer älska det: realistisk körfysik, utmanande hinderbanor, fågelperspektiv och stegrande svårighetsgrad. Ta ratten, kolla speglarna och parkera var som helst!
nodes.short_description: Bemästra konsten att parkera i VR! Sätt dig bakom ratten i Car Parking School, där precision är allt. Navigera genom utmanande hinderbanor och visa att du är en proffsförare.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: ¡El desafío de conducción y estacionamiento más preciso en Meta Horizon! Olvida las carreras de alta velocidad: aquí todo se trata de control y conciencia espacial. Por qué te encantará: física de conducción inmersiva, pistas de obstáculos, vista aérea y dificultad progresiva. ¡Toma el volante, revisa los espejos y estaciona en cualquier lugar!
nodes.short_description: ¡Domina el arte de estacionar en VR! Ponte al volante en Car Parking School, donde la precisión lo es todo. Atraviesa circuitos desafiantes y demuestra que eres un conductor profesional.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Die präziseste Fahr- und Parkherausforderung auf Meta Horizon! Vergessen Sie Hochgeschwindigkeitsrennen – hier zählen Kontrolle und räumliches Bewusstsein. Warum Sie es lieben werden: realistische Fahrphysik, herausfordernde Parcours, Top-Down-Ansichten und steigender Schwierigkeitsgrad. Schnappen Sie sich das Lenkrad und parken Sie wie ein Profi!
nodes.short_description: Meistern Sie die Kunst des Parkens in VR! Setzen Sie sich ans Steuer der Car Parking School, wo Präzision alles ist. Meistern Sie schwierige Hindernisparcours und beweisen Sie Ihr Können.

nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精準的駕駛與泊車挑戰！忘掉高速賽車吧——在這裡，控制力、空間意識和穩定的操作才是關鍵。在複雜的訓練場中體驗每一寸都至關重要的真實駕駛模擬。推薦理由：沉浸式駕駛物理、挑戰性障礙賽道、頂視圖視角以及循序漸進的難度。握緊方向盤，開始你的駕駛課吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨練泊車藝術！走進《Car Parking School》的駕駛室，精準操控就是一切。在充滿挑戰的障礙賽道中穿梭，證明你是終極職業司機。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Cea mai precisă provocare de condus și parcare de pe Meta Horizon! Uită de cursele de mare viteză – aici totul ține de control și orientare spațială. De ce îți va plăcea: fizică de condus realistă, trasee complexe, vizualizare de sus și dificultate progresivă. Ia volanul în mâini și parchează perfect oriunde!
nodes.short_description: Stăpânește arta parcării în VR! Urcă-te la volan în Car Parking School, unde precizia este totul. Navighează prin trasee cu obstacole și demonstrează că ești un șofer profesionist.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Η πιο ακριβής πρόκληση οδήγησης και παρκαρίσματος στο Meta Horizon! Ξεχάστε τους αγώνες ταχύτητας – εδώ μετράει ο έλεγχος και η αντίληψη του χώρου. Χαρακτηριστικά: ρεαλιστική φυσική οδήγησης, δύσκολες πίστες με εμπόδια, προοδευτική δυσκολία. Πάρτε το τιμόνι, ελέγξτε τους καθρέφτες και παρκάρετε παντού!
nodes.short_description: Κατακτήστε την τέχνη του παρκαρίσματος σε VR! Καθίστε στη θέση του οδηγού στο Car Parking School, όπου η ακρίβεια είναι το παν. Περάστε από δύσκολες διαδρομές και γίνετε επαγγελματίας οδηγός.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon에서 가장 정밀한 운전 및 주차 챌린지! 고속 레이싱은 잊으세요. 이곳에서는 컨트롤과 공간 지각력이 핵심입니다. 현실적인 운전 물리 엔진, 도전적인 장애물 코스, 탑다운 뷰, 점진적인 난이도를 경험해 보세요. 스티어링 휠을 잡고 가상 미러를 확인하며 완벽하게 주차해 보세요!
nodes.short_description: VR로 주차의 달인이 되어보세요! 정밀함이 생명인 Car Parking School의 운전석에 앉아 도전적인 장애물 코스를 통과하고 최고의 프로 드라이버임을 증명하세요.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Nejpřesnější parkovací výzva na Meta Horizon! Zapomeňte na rychlé závodění – tady jde o kontrolu a prostorové vnímání. Proč si hru zamilujete: pohlcující fyzika jízdy, náročné překážkové dráhy, pohledy shora i z třetí osoby a progresivní obtížnost. Chopte se volantu, zkontrolujte zrcátka a zaparkujte kdekoli!
nodes.short_description: Ovládněte umění parkování ve VR! Sedněte si za volant v Car Parking School, kde je přesnost vším. Projíždějte náročnými překážkovými dráhami a dokažte, že jste profesionální řidič.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon'daki en hassas sürüş ve park etme deneyimi! Hız yapmayı unutun; burada önemli olan kontrol ve mekansal farkındalıktır. Neden seveceksiniz: sürükleyici sürüş fiziği, zorlu engel parkurları, tepeden görünüm ve artan zorluk seviyeleri. Direksiyona geçin, aynaları kontrol edin ve ustalığınızı gösterin!
nodes.short_description: VR'da park etme sanatında ustalaşın! Hassasiyetin her şey olduğu Car Parking School'da sürücü koltuğuna geçin. Zorlu parkurları aşın ve profesyonel bir sürücü olduğunuzu kanıtlayın.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest presise kjøre- og parkeringsutfordringen på Meta Horizon! Glem racing i høy fart – her handler det om kontroll og romforståelse. Hvorfor du vil elske det: realistisk kjørefysikk, utfordrende hinderløyper, fugleperspektiv og progressiv vanskelighetsgrad. Ta rattet og vis at du kan parkere hvor som helst!
nodes.short_description: Mestre kunsten å parkere i VR! Sett deg i førersetet i Car Parking School, der presisjon er alt. Naviger gjennom utfordrende baner og bevis at du er en proff sjåfør.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精准的驾驶与泊车挑战！忘掉高速赛车吧——在这里，控制力、空间意识和稳定的操作才是关键。在复杂的训练场中体验每一寸都至关重要的真实驾驶模拟。推荐理由：沉浸式驾驶物理、挑战性障碍赛道、顶视图视角以及循序渐进的难度。握紧方向盘，开始你的驾驶课吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨练泊车艺术！走进《Car Parking School》的驾驶室，精准操控就是一切。在充满挑战的障碍赛道中穿梭，证明你是终极职业司机。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Le défi de conduite et de stationnement le plus précis sur Meta Horizon ! Oubliez la vitesse, ici tout est question de contrôle et de perception spatiale. Pourquoi vous allez l'adorer : physique de conduite immersive, parcours d'obstacles variés, vues de dessus et difficulté progressive. Prenez le volant et montrez que vous pouvez vous garer n'importe où !
nodes.short_description: Maîtrisez l'art du stationnement en VR ! Prenez place dans le simulateur Car Parking School où la précision est reine. Naviguez à travers des parcours complexes et devenez un pro du volant.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizon 上最精準的駕駛與泊車挑戰！忘掉高速賽車吧——在這裡，控制力、空間意識和穩定的操作才是關鍵。在複雜的訓練場中體驗每一寸都至關重要的真實駕駛模擬。推薦理由：沉浸式駕駛物理、挑戰性障礙賽道、頂視圖視角以及循序漸進的難度。握緊方向盤，開始你的駕駛課吧！
nodes.short_description: 在 VR 中磨練泊車藝術！走進《Car Parking School》的駕駛室，精準操控就是一切。在充滿挑戰的障礙賽道中穿梭，證明你是終極職業司機。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizonin tarkin ajo- ja pysäköintihaaste! Unohda vauhdikas kilpa-ajo – tässä on kyse hallinnasta ja tilan hahmottamisesta. Miksi rakastat sitä: realistinen ajofysiikka, haastavat esteradat, lintuperspektiivi ja nouseva vaikeustaso. Tartu rattiin, tarkista peilit ja pysäköi täydellisesti!
nodes.short_description: Hallitse pysäköinnin taito VR:ssä! Astu Car Parking Schoolin kuljettajan istuimelle, missä tarkkuus on kaikki kaikessa. Läpäise haastavat esteradat ja näytä taitosi ammattikuskina.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Meta Horizonで最も精密な運転＆駐車チャレンジ！高速レースではなく、コントロールと空間認識能力が試されます。没入感のある運転物理、挑戦的な障害物コース、トップダウン視点、そして徐々に上がる難易度。ハンドルを握り、ミラーを確認して、どこにでも完璧に駐車しましょう！
nodes.short_description: VRで駐車の技術を極めよう！『Car Parking School』の運転席に座り、精密な操作で難関コースを攻略。あなたがプロドライバーであることを証明してください。

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Najbardziej precyzyjne wyzwanie parkowania na Meta Horizon! Zapomnij o wyścigach – tutaj liczy się opanowanie i orientacja w przestrzeni. Dlaczego to pokochasz: realistyczna fizyka jazdy, wymagające tory przeszkód, widok z góry i rosnący poziom trudności. Chwyć za kierownicę i zaparkuj idealnie w każdym miejscu!
nodes.short_description: Opanuj sztukę parkowania w VR! Usiądź w fotelu kierowcy Car Parking School, gdzie precyzja jest najważniejsza. Pokonuj trudne tory przeszkód i zostań zawodowym kierowcą.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest præcise køre- og parkeringsudfordring på Meta Horizon! Glem alt om hurtig racing – her handler det om kontrol og rumlig bevidsthed. Hvorfor du vil elske det: realistisk kørefysik, udfordrende forhindringsbaner, top-down-visning og progressiv sværhedsgrad. Grib rattet og vis os, at du kan parkere hvad som helst!
nodes.short_description: Mestrer kunsten at parkere i VR! Sæt dig i førersædet i Car Parking School, hvor præcision er alt. Naviger gennem udfordrende baner og bevis, at du er den ultimative pro-chauffør.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Самый точный симулятор вождения и парковки на Meta Horizon! Забудьте о скоростных гонках — здесь важны контроль и пространственное мышление. Почему вам понравится: реалистичная физика, сложные трассы, вид сверху и прогрессирующая сложность. Беритесь за руль, смотрите в зеркала и припаркуйтесь идеально!
nodes.short_description: Освойте искусство парковки в VR! Сядьте за руль в Car Parking School, где точность — это всё. Проходите сложные трассы с препятствиями и докажите, что вы профи.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description:
The Most Precise Driving & Parking Challenge on Meta Horizon!

Put your driving skills to the ultimate test with Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator. Forget high-speed racing—here, it’s all about control, spatial awareness, and steady hands. Experience a realistic driving simulation where every inch matters as you maneuver your vehicle through complex training grounds designed to challenge even the best drivers.

Why You Will Love It:

Immersive Driving Physics: Feel the weight and handling of your car as you use your VR controllers to steer through intricate courses.

Challenging Obstacle Courses: From rows of traffic cones to narrow barriers and sharp turns, every level is a new lesson in precision.

Top-Down & Third-Person Views: Master your parking from a clear perspective that helps you judge distances perfectly.

Progressive Difficulty: Start with simple parking spots and advance to expert-level courses that require perfect timing and steering.

Skill-Based Rewards: Earn your way to the top by completing levels without hitting a single obstacle.

Grab the wheel, check your mirrors (virtually!), and show us that you can park anything, anywhere. Your driving lesson starts now!
nodes.short_description: Master the art of parking in VR! Step into the driver's seat of Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator, where precision is everything. Navigate through challenging obstacle courses, tight corners, and narrow pathways to reach the perfect park. With realistic 3D handling and increasingly difficult levels, can you prove you’re the ultimate pro driver?

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Den mest precisa kör- och parkeringsutmaningen på Meta Horizon! Glöm höghastighetsracing – här handlar allt om kontroll och rumsuppfattning. Varför du kommer älska det: realistisk körfysik, utmanande hinderbanor, fågelperspektiv och stegrande svårighetsgrad. Ta ratten, kolla speglarna och parkera var som helst!
nodes.short_description: Bemästra konsten att parkera i VR! Sätt dig bakom ratten i Car Parking School, där precision är allt. Navigera genom utmanande hinderbanor och visa att du är en proffsförare.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: ¡El desafío de conducción y estacionamiento más preciso en Meta Horizon! Olvida las carreras de alta velocidad: aquí todo se trata de control y conciencia espacial. Por qué te encantará: física de conducción inmersiva, pistas de obstáculos, vista aérea y dificultad progresiva. ¡Toma el volante, revisa los espejos y estaciona en cualquier lugar!
nodes.short_description: ¡Domina el arte de estacionar en VR! Ponte al volante en Car Parking School, donde la precisión lo es todo. Atraviesa circuitos desafiantes y demuestra que eres un conductor profesional.

nodes.display_name: Car Parking School: VR Driving Simulator
nodes.long_description: Die präziseste Fahr- und Parkherausforderung auf Meta Horizon! Vergessen Sie Hochgeschwindigkeitsrennen – hier zählen Kontrolle und räumliches Bewusstsein. Warum Sie es lieben werden: realistische Fahrphysik, herausfordernde Parcours, Top-Down-Ansichten und steigender Schwierigkeitsgrad. Schnappen Sie sich das Lenkrad und parken Sie wie ein Profi!
nodes.short_description: Meistern Sie die Kunst des Parkens in VR! Setzen Sie sich ans Steuer der Car Parking School, wo Präzision alles ist. Meistern Sie schwierige Hindernisparcours und beweisen Sie Ihr Können.
